title: 第九章 一个人怎么分不如送她去实验室第十章我要你的外套
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
裴殷？
简妤目光从凌厌执漂亮细长的手指上移开，微微抬起头。
开学到现在，还没见过F5，对于书中这些身高腿长的男主们，她还是挺想养养眼的。
前提是，她得躲在不为人知的隐蔽角落，偷偷欣赏。
而不是像现在，被绑架到f6的地盘上。
简妤心想，大老远飞回别墅，f6大概率是不会让盛越他们进来的。
不然，他何必这么费劲带她过来呢？
但是，疯子的想法，正常人是理解不了的。
“怎么能把客人拒之门外呢。”
凌厌执声音带着笑，丝毫不抗拒盛越两人的到来。
明明不久前，他躲的就是盛越跟裴殷。
他放下简妤的腿，朝对方伸出手，一副玩世不恭的态度，“为你来的，不跟我一块出去见见他们吗？”
拒绝f6，是件很危险的事情。
简妤眨眨眼，思索了下，还是搭上他的手。
她脑子想得不少，隐约也能猜到一些，只是缺乏验证。
借助凌厌执的手，站起来。
简妤低敛着眸，套话：“不一定是来找我的。接下来要是证实你误会了什么，跟我应该没关系吧？”
“我做事，从不迁怒女人”凌厌执薄红的眼皮懒洋洋地掀起，“尤其是，我喜欢的人。”
简妤想翻白眼，忍住了。
正当她觉得套不出来什么时，凌厌执忽然有些自得地开口了：“你觉得蛇的嗅觉，会出错吗？”

嗅觉。
蛇的嗅觉靠什么？简妤不清楚。她怕蛇，蛇相关的信息，是她的盲区。
嗅觉……所以，真的跟她身上的味道有关？
简妤低头闻了闻自己的衣领，别说女主的香水味，就是沐浴露的味道也淡得没什么存在感。
很好，这两个猜测基本可以排除。
“傻了吧唧的，我怎么会喜欢上你这样笨的。”凌厌执拉着她走，眼睛斜斜地低瞥着简妤。
“要是谁都能闻到，你还能活到现在？”
他抓着简妤的手指把玩，眯起眼眸，“放心，没人敢抓你去切片。”
简妤对上他冷凝的目光，敢怒不敢言，没再吭声。
她被牵着下楼，坐到一楼客厅沙发上。
大门开启，长廊外进来两个身量相当的男人。
简妤抬头望去，暗搓搓打量。
如果说，盛越那张脸，像月光揉碎化成，清冷高贵。
那么裴殷可能就长得过分勾人了。
额前冷调的发梢，懒懒散散垂落几缕，墨色的眼眸，像深青的玉石。
content_en:
Pei Yin?
Jian Yu looked away from Ling Yanzhi's beautiful and slender fingers and raised her head slightly.
She hasn't seen F5 since school started, but she still wants to look good at the tall and long-legged male protagonists in the book.
The premise is that she has to hide in a hidden corner unknown to others and admire it secretly.
Rather than being kidnapped to f6's territory like now.
Jian Yu thought to herself that if they flew all the way back to the villa, f6 would most likely not let Sheng Yue and the others in.
Otherwise, why would he bother to bring her here?
However, normal people cannot understand the thoughts of a madman.
"How can you turn away guests?"
Ling Yanzhi's voice was filled with laughter, and he did not resist the arrival of Sheng Yue and the others at all.
Obviously not long ago, he was hiding from Sheng Yue and Pei Yin.
He put down Jian Yu's legs and stretched out his hand towards the other party with a cynical attitude, "I came here for you, why don't you go out with me to meet them?"
Rejecting f6 is a very dangerous thing.
Jian Yu blinked, thought for a moment, and took his hand.
She had a lot of thoughts in her mind and could vaguely guess some, but she lacked verification.
With the help of Ling Yanzhi's hand, he stood up.
Jian Yu lowered her eyes and said: "You may not be here to find me. If it is confirmed that you have misunderstood something, it should have nothing to do with me, right?"
"I never do things to anger women." Ling Yanzhi's thin red eyelids lazily raised, "Especially the people I like."
Jian Yu wanted to roll her eyes, but held it back.
Just when she thought nothing could be done, Ling Yanzhi suddenly spoke with some complacency: "Do you think a snake's sense of smell can be wrong?"
sense of smell.
What does a snake's sense of smell rely on? Jian Yu doesn't know. She is afraid of snakes, and snake-related information is her blind spot.
Smell... So, is it really related to the smell of her body?
Jian Yu lowered her head and smelled her collar. Not to mention the smell of the heroine's perfume, even the smell of shower gel was too light to have any presence.
Very good, these two guesses can basically be ruled out.
"You're stupid, how could I fall in love with someone as stupid as you?" Ling Yanzhi pulled her away and glanced sideways at Jian Yu.
"If anyone could smell it, would you still be alive today?"
He grabbed Jian Yu's fingers and played with them, narrowing his eyes, "Don't worry, no one dares to catch you and slice it up."
Jian Yu met his cold gaze, but she dared not speak out in anger and said nothing.
She was led downstairs and sat on the sofa in the living room on the first floor.
The door opened, and two men of similar stature came in from the corridor.
Jian Yu looked up and looked at it secretly.
If we say, Sheng Yue's face is like the moonlight crushed into pieces, cold and noble.
Then Pei Yin might be too attractive.
A few strands of cold-toned hair fell lazily in front of his forehead, and his dark eyes were like deep blue jade.
